message.content:
Test-coverage fix on branch `feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component` in `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa`, approved by Marcel.

**The gap:** `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSizeChipGroup/index.tsx` seeds its roving-tabindex `focusIndex` state from props on mount (`useState(() => computeFocusIndex(values, selectedValue))`, roughly line 69) and re-syncs it via a `useEffect` keyed on `[values, selectedValue]` (roughly lines 74-76). This logic is correct — independently verified by writing throwaway tests — but the shipped test file, `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSizeChipGroup/index.test.tsx` (227 lines, 16 tests), has zero `rerender()` calls anywhere. Every existing test mounts fresh with fixed props, so nothing in the shipped suite would catch a regression in that resync effect.

**The fix:** add tests that use React Testing Library's `rerender()` (already available via `@testing-library/react`'s `render` return value — check how the existing tests in this file set up `render`/`wrap` and follow the same pattern) to cover at least these two cases:
1. Re-rendering the component with a **different `selectedValue`** than it mounted with — confirm the roving tabindex (the chip that has `tabIndex={0}`/is the natural Tab stop) moves to match the new `selectedValue`, not the one it mounted with.
2. Re-rendering where the **previously-selected chip's value becomes disabled** (its `orderable`/availability flag flips) — confirm focus/tabindex moves off the now-disabled chip rather than staying stuck on it.

Follow this file's own existing conventions exactly: how it wraps components (`IntlProvider`/`MemoryRouter` if used), how it mocks `useMultiStyleConfig`, its assertion style (`getByRole`, etc.), and its test-naming convention (a full sentence describing the behaviour, per `.claude/rules/testing.md`).

**Do not touch** `index.tsx`'s actual logic — it's already correct, this is purely adding missing test coverage for existing, working behaviour. Do not touch any other test file.

When done, report the tests you added and confirm they pass (run just this test file, not the full suite) and confirm `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean. Do not stage, do not commit.

Clean — inserted correctly, no stray blank lines or duplication, and the file structure/spacing matches the surrounding conventions exactly.

## Summary

**File changed:** `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSizeChipGroup/index.test.tsx` (the only file touched — `index.tsx` was read for reference only, never edited, per the instruction not to touch its logic).

Added one new `describe` block, `'ZimmSizeChipGroup — roving tabindex resync on rerender'`, with two tests, inserted after the existing "roving tabindex" block (lines 130-173). The diff is purely additive: `git diff --stat` shows `1 file changed, 45 insertions(+)`, 0 deletions — no existing test or line was altered.

**Conventions followed** (matching the rest of the file exactly):
- Uses the file's own `wrap()` helper (which returns the full RTL `render()` result, so `rerender` is available via destructuring) and its `group()`/`radios()`/`val()`/`FOUR` helpers.
- `rerender()` calls pass the full `<IntlProvider>`-wrapped tree, since `rerender` replaces the whole tree under the same container — matching how `wrap` itself wraps components.
- Same `useMultiStyleConfig` mock (untouched, applies automatically).
- Same assertion style as the adjacent "roving tabindex" tests (`within(group()).getAllByRole('radio').filter(tabindex === '0')`, `toHaveAttribute('data-size-value', ...)`) — reusing the file's own established pattern for distinguishing the real tab-stop chip from a same-text disabled neighbour.
- Test names are full sentences describing behaviour, per `.claude/rules/testing.md`.

**Coverage added, matching both required cases:**
1. `'moves the tab stop to match a new selectedValue passed in after mount'` — mounts with `selectedValue="xs"`, confirms the tab stop starts there, rerenders with `selectedValue="l"`, confirms the tab stop moved to `l` and not the value it mounted with.
2. `'moves the tab stop off the previously-selected size once it becomes disabled'` — mounts with `selectedValue="s"` (enabled), confirms the tab stop starts on `s`, rerenders with the same `selectedValue="s"` but that entry's `isDisabled` flipped to `true`, confirms the tab stop moved off `s` and onto the first enabled entry (`xs`) rather than staying stuck.

Both exercise the exact code path described in the task: `computeFocusIndex` (lines 45-48) re-invoked by the `useEffect` on `[values, selectedValue]` (lines 74-76). I traced through what each test would observe if that effect were removed or its dependency array were wrong — in both cases `focusIndex` would remain stuck at its mount-time value, so the tab stop would stay on `xs` in test 1 and stay on the now-disabled `s` in test 2 — confirming these assertions are non-vacuous regression checks, not just descriptions of already-guaranteed behaviour. (I deliberately did not verify this by physically mutating `index.tsx`, even temporarily, since the task explicitly says not to touch its logic and I'm not permitted to use `git checkout` to revert such a change.)

**Evidence:**
- `npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSizeChipGroup/index.test.tsx` → `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 22 passed (22)` (20 original + 2 new; confirmed original count was 20 via `git show HEAD:...`, not the ~16 estimate in the task description).
- `npx tsc --noEmit` → no output, clean.

No other files were touched; nothing was staged or committed.
